Bangkok Suvarnabhumi (BKK) connects via Airport Rail Link. BTS/MRT cover many areas; boats on Chao Phraya are handy. Peak-hour traffic can be heavy.
London is served by Heathrow (LHR) and Gatwick (LGW). Heathrow Express and Elizabeth Line reach central London. Contactless and Oyster work on Tube and buses.
New York City has JFK, LGA, EWR. AirTrain connects JFK/EWR to rail. The subway runs 24/7; OMNY contactless payment is supported.
Paris has Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly (ORY). RER B connects CDG to central Paris in ~35 minutes. The Metro covers most areas. Booking major attractions in advance is recommended.
Rome's Fiumicino (FCO) connects via the Leonardo Express to Termini. The metro and buses cover the city. Book Vatican Museums ahead of time.
Tokyo has Narita (NRT) and Haneda (HND). Narita Express and Keisei Skyliner connect NRT; Tokyo Monorail and Keikyu Line connect HND. IC cards like Suica/Pasmo are widely accepted.
